capabilities: Capture web pages, wikilinks, block refs, PDF, Canvas, and EPUB locations as reading points
Group reading points into .irdeck topic files stored in the vault
Schedule daily reading with a calendar showing today's queue, overdue items, and load
Resume reading by jumping back to the recorded source location
Import whole Markdown documents or PDF/EPUB chapters as reading material
extras: Freemium: calendar, topics, Markdown reading points, and basic scheduling are free; paragraph workbench, PDF/EPUB chapter import, folder subscription, load deferral, interleaved learning, advanced analytics, and timer require a one-time Weave series license. Detailed tutorials live on an external website rather than in the README. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's bookmarks and folders only store links; nothing built in schedules reading across days or resumes at the exact source position.

relations.evidence: If Weave Deck (main plugin) is installed and activated, authorization can also be inherited.
install and enable Weave EPUB Reader, and add reading points with location links
use PDF++ selection / bookmark links with Add link

requires.name: Weave series activation code (one-time license for premium features)

summary: Standalone incremental reading plugin that turns sources into traceable reading points, groups them in topics, and schedules them on a daily calendar.
